system.description:
Choose one weapon type. Once per round, reroll one missed attack roll with it, and gain +2 to Damage with it. If you already have a class feature granting weapon specialisation (Fighter), this instead applies to a second weapon of your choice, rather than duplicating your first.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

rules.value: Weapon Master: once per round reroll one missed attack with your chosen weapon.
